old: The main experiment evaluates the Hybrid-INoT core and its controls by crossing call topology (one or three fresh model turns) with stage labels (neutral or role-labelled).
new: The main experiment evaluates the Hybrid-INoT core and its controls by crossing call topology (one or three fresh model calls) with stage labels (neutral or role-labelled).
reason: Uses the same precise unit as the subsequent execution description and avoids conflating a call with a conversational turn.
Natural English while preserving the full-history forwarding rule.

old: A separately committed administrative amendment, recorded before held-out quality evaluation or inspection, permits only those never-submitted cells to continue.
new: A separately committed amendment to the run protocol, recorded before held-out quality evaluation or inspection, permits only those never-submitted cells to continue.
reason: Makes clear that the amendment changes execution administration, not the estimand or outcome classification.

old: These checks establish evaluability and negative discrimination, not complete prompt--test semantic validity.
new: These checks establish evaluability and discrimination against deliberately incorrect programs, not complete prompt--test semantic validity.
reason: States exactly what the negative controls demonstrate; the original phrase is technically opaque.

old: Candidate resource means sum their completed constituent turns.
new: Per-candidate resource totals sum the completed turns that constitute that candidate.
reason: Removes the awkward subject and makes the aggregation rule explicit.

old: The four constructed factorial cells do not stand in for a published method.
new: The four constructed factorial cells are not a replication of a published method.
reason: More idiomatic and methodologically explicit wording, matching the Russian statement that the factorial cells do not substitute for the published method.
Avoids the British spelling inconsistency and describes the experimental arm designation directly.

old: The sample comprises the next 80 task IDs in the previously randomized reserved order
new: The sample comprises the next 80 task IDs in the previously randomized order of the reserved pool
reason: Clarifies that the order belongs to the reserved pool rather than implying that the order itself was reserved.

old: All 320 assignments produce complete programs and native outcomes, with no retry, missing result or evaluation timeout.
new: All 320 assignments yield complete programs and native outcomes, with no retry, missing result, or evaluation timeout.
reason: Improves idiomatic results reporting and adds the parallel comma in the enumeration.

old: The primary series' 18.45\% lower single-call role valuation is therefore not convincingly reproduced by this additional wording-and-layout experiment.
new: The additional wording-and-layout experiment therefore does not convincingly reproduce the primary series' 18.45\% lower valuation for the single-call role condition.
reason: Makes the comparison direction explicit and avoids the compressed possessive construction.

old: An absent instance report is not itself an outcome.
new: The absence of an instance report is not itself an outcome.
reason: Uses a complete noun phrase and reads more naturally in the missingness rule.

old: model choice is an economical available coding configuration, not a demonstrated global price minimum.
new: model choice is an economical coding configuration available for this study, not a demonstrated global price minimum.
reason: Removes the awkward adjective order while preserving the explicit limitation on cost claims.
